

Found it — the Norwegian/Blue constraint was implemented backwards (prohibiting adjacent blue, rather than requiring the blue house to be adjacent). I'll fix it:

<tool_call>
<function=edit>
<parameter=new>
    private boolean adjacentOk(int a, int b) {
        int[] x = grid[a], y = grid[b]; // a is left, b is right
        // reading next to fox
        if ((x[3] == 2 && y[2] == 2) || (y[3] == 2 && x[2] == 2)) return false;
        // painting next to horse
        if ((x[3] == 1 && y[2] == 3) || (y[3] == 1 && x[2] == 3)) return false;
        return true;
    }
</parameter>
<parameter=old>
    private boolean adjacentOk(int a, int b) {
        int[] x = grid[a], y = grid[b]; // a is left, b is right
        // Norwegian's neighbor is blue
        if ((x[0] == 4 && y[4] == 4) || (y[0] == 4 && x[4] == 4)) return false;
        // reading next to fox
        if ((x[3] == 2 && y[2] == 2) || (y[3] == 2 && x[2] == 2)) return false;
        // painting next to horse
        if ((x[3] == 1 && y[2] == 3) || (y[3] == 1 && x[2] == 3)) return false;
        return true;
    }
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
<tool_call>
<function=edit>
<parameter=new>
            if (hobby >= 0 && drink >= 0 && hobby == 3 && drink != 4) return false; // football: OJ
            if (nat >= 0 && hobby >= 0 && nat == 3 && hobby != 4) return false;  // Japanese: chess
            // Norwegian's house must have a blue neighbor
            if (nat == 4) {
                if (h == 0) { if (grid[1][4] >= 0 && grid[1][4] != 4) return false; }
                else if (h == N - 1) { if (grid[N - 2][4] >= 0 && grid[N - 2][4] != 4) return false; }
                else {
                    int lc = grid[h - 1][4], rc = grid[h + 1][4];
                    if ((lc >= 0 && lc != 4) && (rc >= 0 && rc != 4)) return false;
                }
            }
</parameter>
<parameter=old>
            if (hobby >= 0 && drink >= 0 && hobby == 3 && drink != 4) return false; // football: OJ
            if (nat >= 0 && hobby >= 0 && nat == 3 && hobby != 4) return false;  // Japanese: chess
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
